image_prompt: photorealistic urban sidewalk scene, red bicycle leaning against a bright yellow fire hydrant, steady rainfall, wet pavement with clear reflections, overcast daylight, highly detailed, no people, no text, no watermarks, no logos

checklist_expected.note: Element checklist alone is not enough — this image satisfies required objects while being geometrically broken.

known_anomalies.issue: rim/tire severed or melted into pavement; spokes do not meet a coherent hub
duplicated or fused steering assembly (two forks / two handlebar sets)
ghosted / overlapping second red frame behind the primary bike

views.name: front
views.note: Zoom on steering/front wheel — full-frame VL often misses anomalies that this crop surfaces.

purpose: Golden negative for artifact-gate eval. Checklist may pass; Qwen3-VL-8B often misses the geometry bug. Gate is not green until acceptance bar in docs/requirements/imagegen-integration.md passes without coerce.
